 Print Latest weather update and forecast for Los Angeles. Los Angeles is experiencing mostly sunny weather on this October 25, 2026. Today's temperatures are expected to peak at a comfortable 27°C, with a low of 15°C during the night. Humidity levels will be relatively high at 84%, but there is no chance of rain, allowing residents to enjoy outdoor activities without the worry of precipitation. Winds will be mild, making it an ideal day for those planning to be outside. Los Angeles Weather Today
 Today's weather in Los Angeles promises a pleasant day characterized by mostly sunny skies. The high temperature will reach 27°C, while the low will settle at 15°C, offering a comfortable range for residents. Humidity will remain elevated at 84%, though the absence of rain means no disruptions for scheduled outdoor events. Expect a gentle breeze throughout the day, with maximum wind speeds reaching around 14.48 kph. Most of the daytime will remain clear, with the sun rising at 7:06 AM and setting at 6:07 PM. No significant temperature drops or severe changes are anticipated, maintaining a steady and enjoyable climate for residents. Good conditions for evening activities
 With beautiful weather on the cards, those in Los Angeles should consider venturing outdoors this afternoon and evening. The dry and mild temperatures will be perfect for various activities, whether you plan a family outing, a picnic in the park, or simply a leisurely stroll after sunset. As the sun sets at 6:07 PM, temperatures will begin to cool but should remain comfortable through the evening. Residents are encouraged to hydrate adequately, especially if engaging in physical activities under the sun. Sunglasses and sunscreen are also advisable, as UV exposure can still be significant even in October. Los Angeles Weather for Upcoming 7 Days

 In the upcoming week, the weather in Los Angeles will remain generally mild with plenty of sunshine. The warmest day appears to be October 26 with a high of 28°C, while temperatures will gradually decrease to around 22-23°C by the end of the week. As the week progresses, residents should prepare for increasing cloud cover, with the likelihood of light showers returning by October 30 and lasting into early November. The mornings may bring brief periods of rain, particularly on October 31. While outdoor plans may require some adaptability towards the end of the week, temperatures will not plummet significantly, ensuring a balance between cooler evenings and comfortable daytime activities.
